item.title: Steam Officially Launches Its 2026 Game of the Year Awards Voting
item.description: The Golden Joysticks has already weighed in on 2026's Game of the Year and The Game Awards has revealed its nominees for this year's best of the best. But one awards ceremony stands apart from the typical Game of the Year awards contest: the Steam Awards.

item.title: Goodbye, Mandy: GTA 6 Players Are Already Obsessed With Someone Else
item.description: As Grand Theft Auto 6 began releasing around the world last week, players quickly became obsessed with Mandy . She's a neighbor of Jason's who tries to seduce the himbo while he fixes her sink. (And she is totally not a serial killer , no way, why would you ask?) Mandy shows up early in GTA 6 . But as more players advance in the game, they're becoming obsessed with a new character: Vicki, a standout character from Chapter 2.

item.title: Every Playable Video Game in GTA 6, Ranked Worst to Best
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is so big that it’s actually five games in one. Like previous games in the series, there are several games-within-the-game that you can play while hanging out in Leonida. These aren’t just quick arcade games that you can play for a few minutes, but full-on console games that are actually pretty fun in their own right.

item.title: 'Dealer's Choice' mission choices and outcomes in GTA 6
item.description: Choosing between pure or cut drugs in Grand Theft Auto 6 is tough; on the one hand, it'll be nice to make extra money… But on the other hand, shady dealings often end in shootouts. More than other GTA 6 missions, the "Dealer's Choice" mission in Chapter 3 has a "best" and a "worst" way to handle things.

item.title: Where to find the Silent Hill hotel in GTA 6
item.description: The Silent Hill hotel is one of the secrets you can stumble upon in Grand Theft Auto 6 . Like the meeting with Dave and Beelzebub , you can miss the chance to enter this specific hotel and experience the creepy event that takes place inside. From the outside, it looks like a regular building, but after you visit this place, Leonida will literally change for a while. Besides, there's a safe waiting for you to open and a unique reward to collect.

item.title: Naruto Movie Officially Casts Fan-favorite Actor for Key Role
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton is gearing up for his next live-action adaptation of an iconic franchise. He's writing and directing a live-action Naruto movie, and is in the process of casting an important role.

item.title: Steven Spielberg Officially Takes On a New Genre for Next Movie
item.description: Steven Spielberg is finally getting his chance to make a Western, and he's bringing some serious star power along for the ride. The legendary filmmaker is developing an adaptation of The Heart in Winter , with Jessie Buckley ( Hamnet ), Cillian Murphy ( Oppenheimer ), and Mark Rylance ( Bridge of Spies ) set to star.

item.title: GTA 6 Hacker Officially Walks Free After Judge's Final Warning
item.description: The man responsible for one of the biggest Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks is finally out of prison, and the judge had one very simple message for him: Don't do it again, mister.

item.title: Where to find the UFO dream house in GTA 6
item.description: If you're looking for the UFO dream house location in Grand Theft Auto 6 , that means you've already seen the UFO itself once. This unmarked optional mission begins when you investigate an abandoned car at the side of the road, follow a trail of clothes strewn on the floor, then discover a woman in a rather unfortunate situation, being beamed up into the sky. The next time you go to sleep, a concerning dream sequence happens, with one part of it showing somewhere in Leonida depicted onto what is supposed to be planet Earth.

item.title: Should you give the statue to Benedict Halifax during 'Dubious Provenance' in GTA 6?
item.description: Giving the statue to Halifax during the Grand Theft Auto 6 "Dubious Provenance" mission may not seem like the wisest choice, but don't be too quick to decide. In this GTA 6 mission, one choice is more rewarding and more time-efficient than the other.
